title: Repository: YES_NO add is idempotent per date; addEntry returns the entry id
findings_note: TrackerRepository.kt:74-88 (addEntry returns Unit and always inserts)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the dashboard buttons and undo UI (S39) and the editor's duplicate-date warning (S14).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- Owner decision: YES_NO counts once per day. Analytics (S34) defends against duplicates, but the data layer should not create them from quick actions.
- One-tap logging with undo (S39) needs the id of the entry that was created.
- `addEntry` inserts the entry and bumps the tracker as two unrelated writes.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerDao.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerRepository.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerViewModel.kt` (call sites only)
- `app/src/androidTest/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerDaoTest.kt` (created in S05; extend it)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Instrumented, on an in-memory Room database with a `TrackerRepository` built from it:
- `yes_no addEntry twice on one date returns the same id and keeps one row`
- `count addEntry twice on one date inserts two rows`
- `yes_no addEntry after the entry was soft-deleted inserts a new row`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. DAO: `@Query("SELECT id FROM entries WHERE trackerId = :trackerId AND effectiveDate = :date AND isDeleted = 0 LIMIT 1") suspend fun findActiveEntryId(trackerId: Long, date: String): Long?`.
2. Change `addEntry` to return `Long` and wrap the body in `database.withTransaction { ... }`. When `trackerType == YES_NO` and `findActiveEntryId` returns an id, return that id without inserting or bumping.
3. Update the ViewModel call sites (they can ignore the return value for now).
4. Leave `updateEntry` alone. A user moving a YES_NO entry onto a date that already has one is allowed here, and S34 counts it once.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest` passes on an emulator or device (API 34 or newer). CI does not run instrumented tests, so run them locally.
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` still passes.
